# Storyboard acceptance stories

`cases.json` contains six fictional source stories and editorially neutral facts.
Offsets are Unicode character ranges `[start, end)`, matching `script_ref`.
Repeated phrases have separate offsets. Dialogue is exact source text.

Only the one-scene and Unicode cases include compact outlines accepted by the
current silent, one-scene planner. The remaining cases preserve requirements
for later multi-scene/dialogue/casting work; they are not qualified model outputs.
Open questions identify limitations or contradictions without choosing creative
answers. No private images, likeness approvals or performance claims are included.

The long fixture has twelve scene beats. It tests route/chunk coverage boundaries,
not a particular model's context-window capacity. Creative camera, acting and
visual-quality acceptance must remain separate from these source-integrity facts.
